title: (fix) O3-6030: Keep hidden obs group members, orders and diagnoses out of submissions
body:
## Requirements

- [x] This PR has a title that briefly describes the work done including the ticket number. If there is a ticket, make sure your PR title includes a [conventional commit](https://o3-docs.openmrs.org/en-US/docs/frontend-modules/contributing/#contributing-guidelines) label. See existing PR titles for inspiration.
- [ ] My work is based on designs, which are linked or shown either in the Jira ticket or the description below. (See also: [Styleguide](http://om.rs/o3ui))
- [x] My work includes tests or is validated by existing tests.

## Summary

Hidden obs group members, test orders and diagnoses no longer get submitted with the encounter, including rows added to repeating fields.

Before this, only hidden top-level obs were dropped. If you filled in a field inside an obs group, or a test order or diagnosis field, and a hide expression then hid it, the value stayed on the field and still went out in the encounter payload. For example, with a Yes/No question controlling a weight obs inside a Vitals group, a test order and a diagnosis, answering Yes, filling them in, then switching to No still posted the weight obs, a `NEW` test order and the diagnosis.

`processObsGroup` now skips hidden members and, in edit mode, voids their stored obs the same way we already do for top-level obs. It reads each member's visibility and stored obs from the flattened form field, because hide evaluation and hydration update that copy rather than the one in the group's `questions`. `prepareOrders` and `prepareDiagnosis` now skip hidden fields too.

Repeated rows had a second problem. When the trigger changed, hide logic threw on the first repeated row it reached (`Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'sections')`, shown as an error toast), because `findFieldSection` looks up the page through `meta.pageId` and `cloneRepeatField` replaces a row's `meta`. That stopped every repeated row from being re-hidden, so their values were still submitted and hidden fields in extra obs group rows stayed visible. `findFieldSection` now returns `undefined` when there's no page.

## Screenshots

Recorded in the patient chart against a local backend, using a test form where a Yes/No question hides a top-level comment, a weight obs inside a repeating Vitals obs group, a repeating test order and a repeating diagnosis. In each run I answer Yes, fill everything in, add a second row to each repeating field, switch to No so those fields are hidden, then save. The panel on the left isn't part of O3. It's an overlay showing the encounter request body captured from the Save click.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/d1d7f718-da3d-40c5-aa8c-68393fd35ca8

Before (form engine from `main`): switching to No throws an error, and both weights, both test orders and both diagnoses still go out with the encounter. The hidden top-level comment is already dropped, since top-level obs were handled before this change.

After (form engine built from this branch): only the trigger and the two temperatures get submitted.

## Related Issue

## Other

A hidden order or diagnosis that's already saved on the encounter is left as is rather than voided, unless it was cleared before being hidden. Patient identifier, person attribute and program state fields have the same missing hidden check. I've left both for a follow-up since they need a decision on what hiding should mean for data that's already saved.
